text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: *pant*... haa...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I went and lost.
Even though I swore I'd win...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: So fwu-strating...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I ended up letting
everyone down, didn't I—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hae?

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Yukino-chan, you were working so hard and looked so cute~!
Great job~!

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Even if you lost, there's always a next time!
Switch gears and smile like you always do~!

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, the concert is next!
Today's main event! Let's get ready!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh, does that mean...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean
you don't want me to win?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Harp Alpha~!!
Great job~! That was a fine run!"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I'm expecting great things from you this autumn too!
I know you're capable of achieving wonderful results!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...I wish...
someone had said that to me too."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"What makes that girl and me
so different, I wonder—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Though narrowly defeated, Yukino Bijin still left a solid result.
Yet, upon her return, her expression showed a mix of feelings beyond just frustration."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ngh.
Traaaineer...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Still, I loooost, waaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Still, none of the fans looked the least bit frustrated.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"It seemed like no one even cared
about how my race went..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Or something like that.
I got way too negative there, huh.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"It's 'cause I lost that
no one understood me, for sure."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Because I couldn't show them the cool running
that I'd always looked up to...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "If I do my best and win at the Shuka Sho, I'm sure I can capture everyone's hearts!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The final race of the Triple Tiara, the Shuka Sho. If she proves her strength here, Yukino Bijin will firmly cement her reputation.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'll run in a way that's totally badass!
If I do, I know something's gotta change...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Right?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Could you say a few words to the fans watching on TV, then?
Oh, in your dialect, please!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The cause likely lies in the gap between who she is and what others expect of her.
Bridging that gap is difficult.
Even so, she is striving to move forward with a positive mindset.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Um!
I have a favor to ask."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"To get results at the Shuka Sho,
I'd like to run in one more race before that."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Because I want to hold on forever
to this feeling of not wanting to lose...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Do ya think... there are any good races for me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In this race with Senior Class runners competing, we can test her strength. It should give Yukino Bijin a boost of confidence before the Shuka Sho.
choice_data_list: We're in the middle of summer camp, so we'll have to travel, but...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine,
I'm used to long trips!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
An' I'm definitely,
absolutely gonna win that race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, before taking on our next target, the Shuka Sho...
we decided to challenge the Queen Stakes first.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—Despite the disappointing result for the spotlighted Yukino Bijin,
she put on a truly magnificent run!"

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
...Incredible.
You're amazing, Yuki-chan.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I've never seen her look so desperate before...
It's way too cool. It's just not fair...

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
—I've gotta hold on tight and keep pushing too.
To make my dream come true, just like Yuki-chan...!
